rule:
Every slab must have a thickness between 30 mm and 1000 mm inclusive.
Source: rule 'Slab Thickness' of the EC3-2026 rule catalogue: This rule checks that slab thickness is not too small or too large.
Benchmark convention: the thickness of a slab is the thickness of its own construction: the total of its material layers or its recorded thickness, or else the depth of its body. A slab fails when it is thinner than 30 mm or thicker than 1000 mm. Roof slabs (IfcSlab with PredefinedType ROOF) belong to the roof and are not assessed: label them NA.

Label every slab.
Report the GlobalId of every element (modelled as IfcSlab) that does NOT satisfy this requirement.

solibri.configuration: The four rule sets of the EC3-2026 Solibri projects (ADA and ABA Accessibility Guidelines, Advanced Space Check, BIM Validation - Architectural, General Space Check) with their classifications, unchanged. EC3 models: their arc.smc; other models: ec3_template.smc (the EC3 smiley_west project with the model replaced through Update Models). Report template CheckingSummaryTemplate - Issue and Components.

reference.status: Labels taken from the Solibri issues of the rule (the authority, as in the EC3 benchmark).
reference.policy: FAIL: a scope element listed by an issue of the Solibri rule whose text matches the message; PASS: every other scope element; NA: IfcSlab ROOF (a roof for Solibri).
reference.limitations: The geometric judgement is Solibri's and is not recomputed independently.
